verdict.rationale: Unity documents WebGL export as a first-party platform target (unity-docs-22), but there is no evidence of a WebGPU backend, payload-size optimization guidance, or community/hands-on validation of WebGL performance or bundle size in the browser. missing for 10: WebGPU support/roadmap evidence, payload-size/optimization documentation, independent hands-on reports of WebGL build size or performance in production.
